content.short: MUA DAO is a decentralized community and governance organization on Mantle focused on ecosystem development and member-driven initiatives.
content.description: MUA DAO is a community-driven decentralized autonomous organization operating within the Mantle ecosystem. The DAO brings together active Mantle community members to coordinate ecosystem growth initiatives, fund development projects, and govern shared community resources through on-chain proposals and voting. Members participate in governance by holding and staking the DAO's governance tokens, with voting power proportional to their stake. MUA DAO represents the grassroots community governance layer of the Mantle Network.
